title: DNA Isolation from Cattle Semen for Long Read Sequencing
author: Erwan Denis

Immidiately before use, prepare a mix containing RLT buffer (Qiagen) and TCEP [Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride] to a final volume of 500µL per sample as follow: - 450 µL, RTL - 50 µL, TCEP Buffer RLT Qiagen Catalog #79216 Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #646547-10X1ML This mixture of a guanidine-based reagent (RLT) and a thiol-free reducing agent facilitate dissociation of disulfide bonds (Wu et al , 2018). - Add 600 µL of 70% ethanol to the pellet - Centrifuge 5000 x g, °C, 2 minutes - Discard supernatant - Almost dry the pellet Room temperature 00:05:00 - Add 50 µL to 100 µL of EB (Qiagen) or TE buffer to eluate DNA - Store DNA at 4°C EB buffer Qiagen Catalog #19086 DNA in EB buffer can be heated to 60°C for 1 hour to dissolve it. Do not vortex or pipet DNA. It is recommended not to freeze the DNA to preserve long fragments. Of the 60 extractions carried out using this protocol, the average size of the fragments generated is around 53 kb, ranging from 25 to 120 kb on average. We expect 30 ug of DNA from a commercial semen straw, but this figure can vary considerably from sample to sample. We obtained absorbance ratios of 260/280 for DNA of around 1.8 nm, and 260/230 ratios averaging 0.5 nm. Low ratios have already been observed using RLT buffer (Wu et al , 2018), but these did not affect PacBio sequencing significantly. Some of these DNA have been sequenced and published in Jourdain et al. 2023. steps.title: Recover spermatozoa from straw
steps.instruction: Empty the 200 µL semen sample into a 2 mL DNA LoBind tube (Eppendorf, Catalog #30108078) by cutting both ends of the straw, then rinse the straw with 200 µL 1X PBS (pH 7.4) at room temperature.

steps.title: Lyse pellet with RLT‑TCEP
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RLT‑TCEP to the pellet, vortex by pulsing at maximum speed for 10 seconds (use a wide‑opening tip if needed), and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL 1X PBS (bringing the volume to ~1 mL), centrifuge at 1000 × g, room temperature, for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant. Optional second wash: resuspend the pellet in 1 mL 1X PBS, centrifuge again at 1000 × g, room temperature, for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant. Perform centrifugation gently so the pellet does not stick.

steps.title: Remove RNA with RNase
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase (Qiagen Puregene Tissue Kit) to the pellet, incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes, then place on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube containing 600 µL isopropanol, invert the tube 25–50 times to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 1 minute (temperature not specified), and discard the supernatant.
